model.boundary: reflecting by omitted outward CTMC jumps
model.budget_matching: trapezoidal control-volume quadrature on the 4D product grid; kappa_bar_h recomputed per grid for exact theta invariance
model.continuation: kappa_theta=(1-theta) kappa_bar_h chi_tube_cell + theta [0.5 chi_near_cell + 15 chi_far_cell] with cell-averaged chi
model.initial_distribution: contact-safe hierarchical selector against the binary node mask (byte-identical bilinear product when already safe)
model.reaction_model: finite-radius Doi volume sink with cell-averaged masks
